They always end up in the wildest situations 🤣
🎬: Minions & Monsters

Minions & Monsters is an upcoming animated film from Illumination, set for a July 1, 2026 release, that follows the Minions as they accidentally unleash monsters in early Hollywood while trying to make a movie, forcing them to team up and save the world. Directed by Pierre Coffin, it features a voice cast including Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, and Jeff Bridges, with music by John Powell, and will include a significant portion in the Minionese language. 

📺: In Theaters July 1, 2026
